title: Declared external sources
description: The plan repository's declaration of the outside systems its artifacts reference: sources.toml at the zone root. One table per alias, and the alias is local to the plan that declares it. The file states where an item lives and how to list the open ones; it never holds a copy of an item. Its absence is legal and means the project declares no source, so the file is earned rather than scaffolded. No key has a read-time default, because a value guessed on a project's behalf is a value nobody wrote down.

sources.description: The declared sources, keyed by alias. The key is expressed as a pattern rather than a fixed property list because the aliases are the project's own naming, and no schema can enumerate them ahead of the project.

^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$.description: One declared source. Both keys are required: a template with no command gives a reader a link and no list, and a command with no template gives a list nobody can follow.

url_template.description: The address of one item, with the placeholder standing where the item's key goes. The placeholder appears exactly once, so rendering a link is a substitution and never a guess.

list_command.description: The command that lists the source's open items, as an argument vector rather than one string, so no shell parses it. Any command meeting the report's contract serves; the specification names none.
